name: Emstek (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Emstek (a white castle between trees on red).
history: Municipal flag of Emstek; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Emstek arms — castle between trees on red
